title: Emberfield Survival 2.0: Pyre Crown

objective.summary: Turn Emberfield Survival into a three-phase boss campaign with Nova Burst, richer enemy roles, persistent progression, and stronger input/mobile support.

changes: Three-phase Ash Verge / Cinderstorm / Pyre Crown campaign
Brutes, ranged Wraiths, enemy projectiles, healing salvage
0-100 Ember Core and player-triggered Nova Burst
Two Cinder Wardens and final Pyre Regent boss
Pyre Crown and Nova Born achievements

handoff.instruction: Release & Deploy should verify the complete v62 package, reconcile it atomically with the latest verified GitHub state without overwriting unrelated work, satisfy the canonical main gate, and only then deploy/promote that exact commit to the established WorldWideGames Vercel project.
